quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on player's increased confidence and perimeter shooting
quotes.excerpt: He's been playing with a little bit more confidence this week. Just feels like he's ready to pull the trigger.
quotes.quote: He's been playing with a little bit more confidence this week. Just feels like he's ready to pull the trigger and certainly he goes in and snaps down rebounds, but he just on the perimeter shot, just looks like he's maybe over a hump on when he's got space he's going to take them, which is where we want him because he's a really good shooter. So, it's good if he can provide space and rebound, he's going to be on the floor.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse says a player has looked more confident on the perimeter lately. He notes that if he can provide spacing and rebounding he is going to be on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on staggering stars and potential rotation lineups
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to take too much from it when there's several key guys missing.
quotes.quote: It's hard to take too much from it when there's several key guys missing, but I think there's certainly some scoring there that will need to be on the floor. I think that Simon will provide some of that as well once we get him in there. It's a couple of situations in a row where we've had Jaylen with what would be maybe the rest of Jaylen, VJ, maybe Simon comes in there with the rest of kind of the second unit, so it could be something we go to.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse is looking at potential rotation adjustments including staggering Jaylen and VJ with Simon to ensure scoring is always on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse evaluates player's ability to run the team
quotes.excerpt: I really like his ability to run the team. He's really communicative, he really gets the guys set up.
quotes.quote: I really like his ability to run the team. He's really communicative, he really gets the guys set up. Obviously, he didn't shake free much for really clear shots that I didn't make. They had a certain coverage for him that we'll be able to let him work on that now and get him a counter move to that. I thought they were pinning him on the side a little bit, but it's just great. I'm happy he got out there for 25 minutes.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse likes the way a player is running the team and communicating. He plans to work on counter moves after seeing how defenses are pinning him on the side.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on player's improved handle and aggressive play
quotes.excerpt: He's made a step forward. It just feels like he's better than he was a year ago.
quotes.quote: He's made a step forward. It just feels like he's better than he was a year ago and that's one of them. I think his handle is getting him through some tighter gaps down the lane and once he punches through, he's going to be in the air. That's important for him getting to the front of the rim, which he's really good at, and we just need him to do it more often.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse sees a step forward in a player's handle this year. He says the improved ball handling is helping him get through tighter gaps to reach the rim.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse praises player's offensive creation and paint presence
quotes.excerpt: I was more impressed with his offensive creation, not only his own shot, but his ability to be in the paint.
quotes.quote: I was more impressed with his offensive creation, not only his own shot, but his ability to be in the paint. You better send some help or he's going to be finishing. He also had a couple nice kick-outs and stuff, and that's good that he can just kind of be a methodical driver. He does it a little bit more with balance and strength than he does with maybe quickness, but he usually gets breaks through the gap and he's heading towards the rim.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse was impressed by a player's ability to be a methodical driver. He says he uses balance and strength to break through gaps and get to the rim.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse provides update on player's Achilles injury
quotes.excerpt: I just saw him for a little bit during the game and just gave him a big hug.
quotes.quote: I just saw him for a little bit during the game and just gave him a big hug. He's been a joy to coach in the short time he's been here. Really a good dude, so we'll just hope for the best.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse offered a brief update on a player dealing with an Achilles injury saying he hopes for the best for him.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on player's versatility and scoring areas
quotes.excerpt: He's got a lot of areas he can score at, obviously the face-up dribble-drive stuff.
quotes.quote: He's got a lot of areas he can score at, obviously the face-up dribble-drive stuff. He can vault up for a corner three, gets his body set, can rise up over people and make tough threes. He's got a post game, too. That's good, and we'll move him around all the places he can score from.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse highlights a player's offensive versatility noting he can score via dribble drive, corner threes, and a post game.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on defensive improvements and physicality
quotes.excerpt: I really thought we did a good job of squaring up and chesting the ball.
quotes.quote: I really thought we did a good job of squaring up and chesting the ball when they were trying to drive. Our guys were doing a good enough job of keeping their guys in front with some physicality. They still got us on some of the cutting stuff with those guys, but I think improved from Saturday. We watched a bunch of film this morning on some of that, so it was improved. Our physicality was pretty decent on and off the ball, so it was pretty good and we've been really emphasizing getting our defense set up and we did a pretty decent job of getting back tonight.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse says the team showed improved physicality and defensive positioning tonight compared to Saturday.
